title: Engine verification and smoke matrix
purpose: Verify IC/LT engine and graph invariants; measure runtime and between-replicate sd to size EXP-002 (exploratory)
primary_outcome: pass/fail of verification checks; runtime; sd_diff
status: exploratory runs (2026-11-24 smoke and probe; 2026-11-25 M3 pre-run smoke and metric validation); report.md not written (tool refusal); protocol text frozen v1.0

title: IC topology x transmission x initial exposure
purpose: Primary test of topology effect on final cascade fraction at matched N and mean degree
primary_outcome: final cascade fraction S: Delta_WS(p) and Delta_BA(p) vs ER at each of 7 p
status: complete (confirmatory, run 2026-11-25): 13 of 14 Holm rejections; report.md not written (tool refusal)
planned_analysis: Paired cluster bootstrap over 120 graph replicates (B=10000); Holm over 14 per-p contrasts; Holm-step intervals (protocol 11.3)

title: Fractional-threshold topology x threshold x initial exposure
purpose: Secondary: does the topology ordering depend on the contagion model
primary_outcome: final cascade fraction S under threshold model
status: complete (confirmatory, run 2026-11-25): 2 of 2 Holm rejections; report.md not written (tool refusal)
planned_analysis: As EXP-002 on the grid mean over phi 0.18-0.30 (seed count 10); Holm over 2 contrasts

title: Sensitivity analyses S1-S4 for EXP-002
purpose: Test whether degree moments; edge-count mismatch or finite size explain the EXP-002 effect
primary_outcome: final cascade fraction S contrasts under S1-S4
status: complete (confirmatory, run 2026-11-25): S1 10/10, S2 3/7, S3 13/14, S4 optional 13/14 at N=500 and N=2000; S1 cross-reading unresolved (owner); report.md not written (tool refusal)
planned_analysis: Per-parameter contrasts; Holm within each of S1-S4; protocol 11.3 intervals

title: Second test on a real network (IC)
purpose: Does a real friendship network differ from G(n,M) and degree-preserving nulls in IC final size at calibrated p
primary_outcome: final cascade fraction S: real minus real_er and real minus real_dpr at each of 7 calibrated p
status: complete (confirmatory, run 2026-11-25): 11 of 14 Holm rejections; report.md not written (tool refusal)
planned_analysis: Paired cluster bootstrap over 120 matched sets (B=10000); Holm over 14; protocol 11.3 intervals
